dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Duke was surrendered to the care center by his previous owners as, due to their personal circumstances, they did not have time to care for him. His previous owners describe Duke as a funny, smart, affectionate dog who loves car rides and playing outside. Duke has not acclimated well to the kennel environment. He has shown high levels of fear, being avoidant of handlers, consistently seeking exit, urinating during medical restraint, and snapping at medical staff when attempting to examine his mouth. While in a home environment, Duke has bitten the hand of an unfamiliar person he was fearful of, who attempted to play with him. This was a bite and release incident that did not break skin. Duke has also displayed resource guarding in the home, barking and growling over toys. Due to the behavior shown in the home and care centers, we recommend that Duke be placed in an adult-only home through a New Hope partner, who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Duke
